page_title: ANG 0-3 LYO | Angers v Lyon 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) for his blatant foul.

90+2' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
90+1' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' We are about to witness a subsitution. Wilfried Zaha (Lyon) for Malick Fofana.

88' 0 - 3 An amazing individual effort from Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the top right corner and makes it 0:3. Yahia Fofana was helpless.
88' The resulting corner, taken by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon), comes to nothing.

87' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) is first to the rebound and sends a header goalwards but it's blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The linesman makes the right call and Lyon will have a corner.
87' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
86' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner.
84' Chance! Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the top of the net, but Yahia Fofana is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
84' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) is replacing Nemanja Matic.
82' Here is a change. Nicolas Tagliafico is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Abner (Lyon).
81' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:8.
78' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and it's Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
76' Substitution. Farid El Melali makes way for Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers).
76' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Florent Hanin is replaced by Jacques Ekomie (Angers).
76' That's the end of the game for Jean-Eudes Aholou, who is replaced by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers).
76' A cross from a corner kick by Angers is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

75' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The linesman points to the corner flag, Angers are going to take it.
72' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Angers, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
71' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle. Jordan Veretout (Lyon) commits a foul after dangerous play. Angers are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
71' Himad Abdelli (Angers) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
68' The game has come to an end for Alexandre Lacazette. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Georges Mikautadze (Lyon).
68' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rayan Cherki.
65' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Esteban Lepaul (Angers) replaces Jim Allevinah.
64' Half-chance! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) plays a pass into the box, but Yahia Fofana reacts well to snuff out the attack.
62' Lyon failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

62' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
61' Farid El Melali (Angers) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lyon.
58' Lucas Perri pulls off a great save to deny Jim Allevinah (Angers), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
56' The referee signals a substitution. Ibrahima Niane (Angers) is brought on as a substitute for Bamba Dieng.
55' 0 - 2 Goal! Ainsley Maitland-Niles plays a simple square pass into the feet of Rayan Cherki (Lyon) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
53' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is penalised for a foul. Marc Bollengier had a clear view and blows his whistle.

50' Farid El Melali (Angers) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
48' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+4' Himad Abdelli (Angers) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the left post.
45+4' It will be a corner kick for Angers.
45+4' Lucas Perri (Lyon) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+3' Lucas Perri (Lyon) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+3' Farid El Melali (Angers) tried his luck from a long-range free kick, but the effort came back off the left post!
45+2' Lyon are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
45+2' Marc Bollengier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jordan Veretout (Lyon) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Angers.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

44' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed into the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
41' Lyon work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

41' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Yahia Fofana has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
41' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

38' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
37' Lyon try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
37' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) makes a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul. Lyon have a free kick.
35' The possession of the ball – 30:70.

33' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
30' Clinton Mata (Lyon) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

26' 0 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes inside the right post, increasing the score of today's match – 0:1.
26' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is about to take a corner kick.

26' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee points to the corner flag and Lyon will take a corner.
26' Lyon force a corner. They send men into the box.
23' Clinton Mata (Lyon) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
21' Jim Allevinah (Angers) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
19' The ball possession at the moment is 29:71.
16' Bamba Dieng (Angers) might have got lucky there after the VAR review resulted in referee Marc Bollengier deciding not to issue any card.

14' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Bamba Dieng (Angers), but referee Marc Bollengier must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
13' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) duly receives a yellow card.
11' Lucas Perri displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jim Allevinah (Angers) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
8' An indirect free kick, taken by Farid El Melali (Angers), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
7' Angers are all set to take the indirect free kick from inside the box. These situations are quite rare and everyone is curious what they are going to do with it.
6' Yahia Fofana pulls off a great save to deny Malick Fofana (Lyon), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
6' Lyon try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
6' Himad Abdelli (Angers) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick is awarded to Lyon.

4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lyon are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half has started.
Lyon will kick-off.
Marc Bollengier was nominated as the referee for this game.
